descriptors.concept_name: Time of Supply Framework for Goods and Services
descriptors.definition: The time of supply indicates the exact point when the liability to pay goods and services tax arises for intra-State or inter-State transactions. While the tax liability crystallizes at this specific time, the actual payment can be made by the prescribed due dates.
exclusion: Due dates for payment of tax
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from the payment of tax due date which occurs later in the filing cycle

descriptors.concept_name: Statutory Definitions for Time of Supply
descriptors.definition: Statutory definitions establish legal meanings for terms such as associated enterprises, documents, invoices, goods, services, and reverse charge mechanisms. These definitions provide the necessary foundation for interpreting time of supply provisions across transactions.
inclusion: Definition of movable property and actionable claims
Definition of services including money conversion activities
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between physical goods and intangible services or actionable claims

descriptors.definition: The time of supply for goods is determined as the earliest of the invoice issue date, the last date required for invoice issuance, or the date of payment receipt. For reverse charge supplies, specific alternative rules apply involving goods receipt, payment entry, or thirty days post-invoice.
inclusion: Forward charge supply rules for goods
Reverse charge supply rules for goods
exclusion: Time of supply rules for services
nearby_distinctions: Differs from service rules by prioritizing delivery milestones and different reverse charge timelines

descriptors.definition: The time of supply for services is generally determined as the earliest of the invoice issue date or payment receipt, provided the invoice is issued within the prescribed period. Under reverse charge mechanisms, it relies on payment dates or sixty days from the supplier's invoice.
exclusion: Time of supply rules for goods
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from goods by incorporating the exact date of service provision and recipient book entries when standard rules fail

descriptors.concept_name: Time of Supply under Change in Rate of Tax
descriptors.definition: When tax rates change, the time of supply overrides standard provisions to depend strictly on the chronological relationship between the date of supply, invoice issuance, and payment receipt. Specific permutations dictate whether the supply occurs before or after the rate revision.
inclusion: Supplies made before tax rate change
Supplies made after tax rate change
exclusion: Standard forward charge time of supply without rate changes
nearby_distinctions: Applies specialized ordering rules based on rate change timing rather than standard invoice or payment precedence
